verdict_exposure: SELECTION_EFFECT -- all variants ~100% invested in 2022; gap is purely which names were held
verdict_h6_h8: PARTIAL -- beta modestly elevated in candidates (esp V28 +7.7pts) but unique picks are NOT higher beta; dominant mechanism is concentration + slow rotation

root_cause_per_variant.V28: Concentration (13.5 names) amplifies MU (-48%) and EPAM (-49%) each at ~9% weight; unique names are mostly winners; slower rotation vs V11
root_cause_per_variant.V31: Beta-residual signal picks energy correctly but is slow to rotate; NCLH (-45%) at 9% weight; unique names near flat; worst 2022 gap (-9.5%)
root_cause_per_variant.V26-robust: Most similar to V11 (20.9 names); unique names slightly negative; ECL/AOS unique detractors; smallest gap (-2.8%)

hybrid_implication: Concentration constraint (position count floor = V11-equivalent 20+ names) plus turnover floor may be more effective than beta-dampening alone; H6/H8 BEAR protection adds another layer but is not the primary 2022 lever
